desc:
Based on a manga and our previous game!

Basic Controls :

Double tap 'W' to RUN 
While running pressing 'R' will toggle between jog/sprinting
'Q' to DASH
Hold F with your combat style tool to BLOCK
F + LMB for perfect block on guard break move
F + RMB for counter on any hit
LMB for attacking
RMB for GUARD BREAK

Developers :
- IncredibleAyum, Yolomura, 
streetjess, MisterAokiji, dodorider, IncredibleJuIes

Contributors :
- MoltenPrime, Tacomura

Premium players have a +8% stat gain boost
